subject: MAP: Activation ops + cutover window for Lighthouse PoC environment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@lighthouse.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: activation ops + cutover window for Lighthouse PoC environment

Hi Elena / Samir —

Excited to get the PoC runway moving. Per our SDR sync, I sketched a short MAP focused on the environment activation items we need to hit for the first two-week evaluation: org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. I attached a one-page checklist (redwood-map-checklist.xlsx).

High-level asks for your team to confirm by EOD Thursday:
- Confirm which email(s) should be the org admin in Redwood (we'll add them to the organization and grant Owner + Billing).
- Provide the public CIDR blocks (or specific IPs) you want us to allow for the API & control-plane callbacks (we'll apply to the allowlist).
- Confirm whether you prefer us to initiate VPC peering or for your infra team to create the peering request (we can support either).

Proposed cutover window for the PoC: July 23–Aug 6 (two weeks). If you need an earlier start, we can compress tasks but will need the org admin + IP info today.

Next steps from our side once we have answers: provision dev org, issue scoped API key(s) for the PoC, and open the peering workflow.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Elena Morris <elena@lighthouse.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@lighthouse.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: activation ops + cutover window for Lighthouse PoC environment

Thanks Jonas — can do. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Org admin: please add me (Elena Morris) and Samir as org admins.
2) IP allowlist: our infra team is in front of NAT egress; they can provide the exact /32s but for now provisional egress is 35.198.0.0/16 and 34.98.0.0/16 (GCP ranges). We'll confirm precise /32s by Thu EOD.
3) VPC peering: we'd prefer Redwood to issue the peering request (we've found that faster historically). Can you share the peering template and required fields?

We have a tight procurement window — procurement needs a signed SOW before licensing can finalize. I attached the signed SOW we prepared (lighthouse-signed-sow.pdf) and copied procurement on a separate thread.

Also — do you have a scoped API key model (read-only vs read-write) so we can scope tokens to evaluation use? Security wants to limit token scope.

Best,
Elena

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@lighthouse.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: activation ops + cutover window for Lighthouse PoC environment

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and the signed SOW. Short answers inline and an action plan below.

1) Org admin: we'll add you and Samir as Owners and enable billing access for the PoC org. I'll send the invite once the org is provisioned.

2) IP allowlist: provisional CIDRs are fine to stage. We'll apply 35.198.0.0/16 and 34.98.0.0/16 as a placeholder and update to exact /32 entries when you send them. Note: for Webhook callbacks we also need an allowlist for callback destinations — if you expect callbacks to internal endpoints, share those URLs.

3) VPC peering: we'll initiate the peering request. Please confirm the following fields so we can populate our request: your VPC project ID, VPC name, GCP region, and the primary CIDR range for routing. I'll attach the peering template in my follow-up but below is the immediate action plan: 

Action plan (timeline compressed to support your procurement):
- Thu 12 Jul: Redwood provisions PoC org, adds org admins, and pre-stages API key scope templates (read-only, read-write, admin).
- Fri 13 Jul: Redwood initiates VPC peering request and applies provisional IP allowlist.
- Mon 16 Jul: Lighthouse confirms precise /32 IPs and any callback URLs; Redwood finalizes allowlist and hands over final API keys.
- Tue 17 Jul: Test call & smoke tests. Target go-live (PoC start) Wed 18 Jul if all green.

I'll attach the peering template and a short runbook in a follow-up message. If procurement needs anything else for billing signoff, loop them into this thread.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@lighthouse.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: activation ops + cutover window for Lighthouse PoC environment

Elena / team —

I work with Jonas on runbooks. Quick notes to speed things up:
- Peering template: we need the project id, VPC name, and the peer ASN only if you are on AWS; for GCP the project id + VPC name + primary CIDR are enough. I pasted a minimal template below.
- Tokens: we issue scoped API keys for PoC. Typical pattern we use: one read-only key for ingestion/embeddings, one read-write key for generation testing. Both keys can be time-limited to the PoC duration and limited to the PoC org.

Minimal peering template (fill and reply):
Project ID: __________
VPC name: __________
Primary CIDR: __________
Contact for peering ops: name/email/phone

If you can return that by EOD we can create the peering request and aim for the Tue 17 Jul smoke tests. I also uploaded a short checklist to the Drive (link above) — feel free to grant Marissa edit rights and I'll co-manage the runbook with your infra lead.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Customer Enablement
redwood.ai

From: Elena Morris <elena@lighthouse.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: activation ops + cutover window for Lighthouse PoC environment

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks — confirm all good on our end. Answers below and next steps: 

- Org admin: adding me (elena@lighthouse.ai) and Samir (samir@lighthouse.ai).
- Peering template: filled below.
  Project ID: lighthouse-prod-01
  VPC name: vpc-lh-core
  Primary CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16
  Peering contact: Samir Patel <samir@lighthouse.ai> / +1 212-555-0148
- Exact egress IPs: Samir attached the /32 list to procurement but provisional ranges you set are fine for staging — final /32s will land Mon 16 Jul.
- Callbacks: no internal callback URLs for PoC — we will use only Redwood-hosted callbacks.
- Procurement: SOW is signed and in DocuSign (link above). We expect billing to be approved by Tue 17 Jul.

We granted Marissa edit access to the Drive folder. Please go ahead and create the org + issue provisional keys so we can start smoke tests on Tue.

Elena
Elena Morris | Director of Platform
Lighthouse AI
elena@lighthouse.ai
